definition: to stay somewhere longer than needed because you do not want to leave
sentence: We {lingered} at the cafe until it closed.
translation: Мы засиделись в кафе до самого закрытия.

definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
sentence: He {deceived} everyone about where the money came from.
translation: Он всех обманул насчёт того, откуда взялись деньги.

definition: very careful, so that nothing bad happens
sentence: Be {cautious} on the stairs, they are wet.

definition: to express an idea or plan in clear words
sentence: Give me a minute to {formulate} my answer.
translation: Дай мне минуту, чтобы сформулировать ответ.

definition: existing in large amounts, more than enough
sentence: Fresh fish is {abundant} and cheap in this town.
translation: Свежей рыбы в этом городе полно, и она дешёвая.

definition: to say something that makes a worried person feel calm
sentence: The nurse {reassured} me that the test was routine.
translation: Медсестра успокоила меня, сказав, что анализ обычный.

definition: refusing to change your mind even when you should
sentence: He's too {stubborn} to ask for directions.
translation: Он слишком упрямый, чтобы спросить дорогу.

definition: not working or being used, doing nothing
sentence: The machine has been {idle} since the factory closed.
translation: Станок простаивает с тех пор, как закрыли завод.

definition: believing people too easily because you have little experience
sentence: I was {naive} to think the landlord would fix it quickly.
translation: Наивно было думать, что хозяин быстро всё починит.

definition: not able to change or bend, very strict
sentence: Her diet is so {rigid} that she can't eat out.
translation: Её диета такая строгая, что она не может есть в кафе.

definition: very bright, clear and strong, easy to imagine
sentence: I still have a {vivid} memory of my first day at school.
translation: Я до сих пор ярко помню свой первый день в школе.
